$comment: Taxonomy-valued fields carry an x-taxonomy annotation naming the dimension in factory/policies/taxonomy.yml. The runtime validates those values against that file at write time; enums are never inlined here to avoid drift between the schema and the taxonomy (architecture §8).
title: Lesson
description: A typed, principle-level memory entry (architecture §9). Instance-level transcripts are rejected at the gate. Bi-temporal supersession with provenance: nothing self-modifies without operator approval.

statement.description: Abstract, transferable, checkable principle — never an instance-level transcript.

superseded_by.description: lesson_id of the lesson that superseded this one, or null.

invalidated_by_event_id.description: Set when a later run contradicts this lesson (lesson_status: invalidated).

provenance_event_ids.description: Event-log entries that produced this lesson (traceable, never silent deletion).

evidence.description: Short excerpt/summary of the error or decision checkpoint that generated this candidate.

finding_category.description: Phase 7 (lessons.ts): optional — only meaningful for a `rule`-typed, claim-path/stack-wide-scoped entry. Compiled into lessons.md's same-mistake entry format so severity.ts can match a new finding's category against it (architecture §9.7). Not required at write time — agent-role/case-type-scoped entries never carry one (lessons.md: "do not participate in this per-file match").

claim_path.description: Phase 7 (lessons.ts): optional glob (picomatch), meaningful only for claim-path/stack-wide-scoped entries — the file pattern this lesson's same-mistake match applies to. Omitted/treated as "**" for stack-wide entries (lessons.md convention).

agent_role.description: D-129: the selector an agent-role-scoped entry is filtered by at dispatch — required for that scope and ignored for every other. Without it the entry reaches no role at all, because the three selector scopes (claim-path/agent-role/case-type) each filter on exactly one field and a missing selector matches nothing rather than everything.

case_type.description: D-129: the selector a case-type-scoped entry is filtered by at dispatch — the taxonomy `case` of the dispatching task, read off the immutable plan. Required for that scope, ignored for every other.
